note: Hand-authored catch-all for real mechanisms that don't fit components/models/endpoints/memory/gaps categories.

dailyQuotaGovernor.statement: Requests per model per day are counted server-side, persisted to disk, and reset at UTC-date rollover; the UI can warn before a run fails.
dailyQuotaGovernor.correction: Relabeled from 'gate' 2026-09-06: cited to real code, no named automated test exercises the counting/persistence logic itself. See de-clutter-protocol-finder-of-truth.md / declarations-clarification-correction.md.
dailyQuotaGovernor.crossReference: gemini-3.7-flash is also the default MODELS.builder (server.js:163) — its 20/day default limit is the same number HARNESS.md's repair-pass arithmetic (up to 30 requests) is measured against. See harness-agentic-loop.json / hetrodox-unconventional-approaches.json.
dailyQuotaGovernor.declaredButNotEnforced: Approximate by design (comment at server.js:170): the governor warns, it does not block. A build that starts under quota can still exceed it mid-generation; nothing here stops that from happening, it only informs the UI.

featureFlags.statement: Disabled features are hidden from the UI entirely and their code paths are unreachable until re-enabled.

imageEdit.reason: needs current image model verified live

videoGen.reason: needs Veo 3.1 verified live + poll-loop hardening

liveAudio.reason: needs server-side ephemeral tokens — the raw key must never reach the browser

pyodide.reason: model-generated Python runs only after explicit user approval

portConvention.statement: The backend must run on 8050, not 8080 — 8080 is contended by other tools on this device and a stranger holding it hangs the dev proxy instead of failing it.

mechanism.note: PORT env var overrides; API_TARGET must move with it for the Vite proxy

portConvention.incidentHistory: CONSOLIDATED-PATH.md's Stage 1 record: an unrelated project's server already held :8080 and answered /healthz with {status:'ok'}, which made a preview-readiness probe pass against the wrong process. The default was moved to :8050 partly because of this.

dualEnvFilePrecedence.statement: Credential precedence is shell env > .env.auth > .env; a value the caller explicitly set in the shell is never overridden by a file, specifically so smoke:memory's deliberately-invalid key stays invalid.

mechanism.note: fromShell captured before dotenv loads either file

dualEnvFilePrecedence.correction: Relabeled from 'gate' 2026-09-06: cited to real code; smoke:memory relies on a bad key staying bad but doesn't specifically assert this precedence chain in isolation. See de-clutter-protocol-finder-of-truth.md / declarations-clarification-correction.md.

onDeviceDevWorkflow.statement: This runs on Android/PRoot; node_modules cannot live on shared storage (no symlinks), so the working repo is /root/multi-app and sources are mirrored to /mnt/sdcard for backup.

factCheckingArtifacts.statement: A `.vouch/` directory of per-session 'reads' manifests exists at repo root, produced by the `vouch` skill (fact-checking Claude's own prior answers against real files).

mechanism.staleness: not-applicable — not a single trackable file (a glob or a directory)

factCheckingArtifacts.note: Tooling artifact, not part of the app; untracked in git. Not further investigated as part of this audit.
